title: TC5 Top Load Washer
sub: Matte black, 3.2 cu. ft., Classic Clean
lead: The TC5 is the traditional Speed Queen, in matte black: an agitator, a Deep Fill option, and a lid that never locks. Six cycles on a dial and a two-speed motor, backed for five years, parts and labor.

features.name: Speed Queen Classic Clean
features.line: Speed Queen's classic agitator wash, which it describes as its more aggressive wash action. A Deep Fill option is on the panel for the loads that call for more water.

features.name: No lid lock
features.line: The lid never locks. Open it at any point in the cycle to add what was missed, or to look in on a soak.

features.name: Six cycles on a dial
features.line: Normal Eco, Perm Press, Heavy Duty, Bulky/Sheet, Delicate and Spin, with four water temperatures from cold to hot.

features.name: Two speeds, stainless tub
features.line: A two-speed 1/2 HP motor turns a stainless steel wash tub, an automatic balancing system keeps the load in line, and the final spin reaches 710 rpm.

features.name: Five years, parts and labor
features.line: Speed Queen backs the TC5 with a 5-year warranty that covers parts and labor.

specs: None: the lid opens at any point in the cycle
